resources.string: Capture what matters. Keep the evidence. Recall it later.
Audio is recorded on this phone, encrypted, and never leaves it without your say.
Audio is being saved on this phone in encrypted one-minute segments.
The microphone is off. Nothing is being recorded.
Your schedule paused recording. The microphone is off and it resumes by itself when quiet time ends.
Microphone permission is off. Allow it in Settings to record.
Another app or the system is using the microphone.
Paused for a phone call. Recording continues when the call ends.
Open the app to start recording. Android doesn\'t allow starting from the background.
Storage is almost full. Free up space to keep recording.
This phone\'s secure key storage isn\'t working, so audio can\'t be saved safely. Nothing unencrypted was recorded.
Recording notifications are turned off, so the microphone was switched off. Turn them back on to keep recording.
The app was closed by the system while recording. Nothing was recorded after that.
Your phone restarted while recording. Nothing was recorded after that.
No audio has been saved recently. Recording may have stopped.
The microphone is delivering only silence. It may be blocked.
Storage is full. Recording will stop to protect saved audio.
A lot of audio is waiting to upload. It is only on this phone.
Watch disconnected. Recording on the phone is unaffected.
Unlock your phone to start recording.
Microphone access is needed to record.
Notifications are needed so the recording indicator is always visible.
Storage is full. Free up space to start recording.
Parts of this session weren\'t saved. They are marked, never filled in.
AI Daily Memory records your day so you can recall decisions and promises later. Audio stays encrypted on this phone. You can pause or stop from the notification at any time.
While recording, a notification always shows that the microphone is on, with Pause and Stop. Recording never happens without it.
Android won\'t ask again. Open Settings, choose Permissions, and allow it there.

Some phones stop apps running in the background. Recording runs as a foreground service, which is usually allowed. If you ever see \"Recording interrupted\", allowing unrestricted battery use can help.
Nothing is being recorded right now
That action isn\'t available right now
Shows while the microphone session is active. Required so recording is never hidden.
Your morning reminder to start the day. Recording never starts by itself.
Your sleep schedule ended, so recording picked up again. Tap Pause any time.
Tap Start My Day when you\'re ready. Recording never starts on its own.
Tells you when recording stopped unexpectedly and needs you.
No sessions yet. Tap Start My Day to begin.
No transcript yet. Speech is transcribed while your phone charges on Wi-Fi, once your account is connected.
Keep it to 60 characters or fewer.
Line breaks and hidden characters can\'t be used.
Couldn\'t save the name. Try again.
This permanently deletes this session and its on-phone audio, transcript, and notes. This can\'t be undone.
Stop this session before deleting it
This session has a server copy. Delete it there first; local deletion was not performed.
Couldn\'t fully delete this session. Try again.
Keep the session and its on-phone evidence for review and processing, or delete the session and its local data now.
Your day runs from waking up to bedtime, not midnight to midnight, so a late conversation stays with the evening it belongs to.
Different on Friday and Saturday nights
Recording stops at bedtime, so nothing runs overnight.
A notification at wake-up. Recording never starts by itself.
Recording pauses by itself and resumes afterwards. If you pause it yourself, it stays paused.
Recording will no longer pause for it.
Your sleep schedule was set up in a way this screen can\'t show, and it\'s still active.
Start over with 11 PM to 7 AM
Automatic deletion follows the setting below after processing and a recovery period. Audio still waiting for a transcript stays on this phone. Audio with no detected speech can also be deleted.
Enter a name of up to 40 characters.
Start and end must be different.
Your transcripts are what\'s kept. Audio is only needed until it has been transcribed. Audio sent for transcription is always deleted from the cloud afterwards.
Keep audio on this phone for 7 days
Keep audio on this phone for 30 days
Keep audio until I delete it
Uses about %1$s of this phone\'s storage at 10 recorded hours a day.
Grows every day. If storage fills up, recording stops; nothing you kept is deleted.
Your previous schedule couldn\'t be read, so none is active. Set it again below.
Connect to transcribe speech while your phone charges on Wi-Fi. Use the server address and device token provided by your server administrator.
Speech is processed on your server even in Phone only mode. Recording works without an account.
Your account connection was signed out. Connect again with a new device token.
This phone can no longer read its saved connection. Connect again.
That doesn\'t look like a device token (it starts with adm_).
The server didn\'t accept this token. Check it or ask for a new one.
Couldn\'t reach the server. Check the address and your connection.
Couldn\'t store the token securely on this phone. Nothing was saved.
Also transcribe speech already recorded on this phone
Speech clips upload while charging on Wi-Fi. Audio stays on this phone until its transcript is stored.

resources.string: An old connection couldn\'t be revoked from this phone. Ask for its device token to be revoked on the server.
Your previous connection will be revoked on the server as soon as this phone is online.
Phone only — transcripts stay on this phone
Reports in the cloud — daily reports are stored on the server; transcripts stay on this phone
Full cloud — transcripts and reports are stored on the server
Updates arrive from the project\'s GitHub releases. The app checks automatically each time it opens.
Downloading the update. This can take a minute on slower connections.
Version %1$s is downloaded and ready to install.
Couldn\'t check for updates. Check your connection and try again.
The download didn\'t finish. Your version keeps working; try again.
Transcribe and summarize on this phone. Free with on-device models, or use your own API key for higher quality. Audio is deleted after transcription.
Processing is off. Enable it to transcribe speech and build daily memory summaries on this phone.
Your key is stored on this phone only and never sent to us.
Frees storage automatically once the transcript is saved. The transcript is kept so you can verify any summary.
Push daily summaries and memory items to your own server for cross-device querying. Never sends audio.
No memory yet. Start recording and enable processing to build your daily memory.
